notes: Help example m1 aov(yield ~ year*env*block*gen - year:env:block:gen), the ANOVA Shaw and Bose compute on p. 141 (Shaw 1936), every term fixed; rendered with random blocks at low (mead.germination ruling), published_model no as for the other fixed-block renderings. The block labels B1 to B5 repeat in each location-year and the plots moved from year to year, so the block is env:year:block; the aov's omitted year:env:block:gen is the residual, and its block-by-genotype terms fold into it. year (3 levels, factor(year) in the example) and env (Pusa unirrigated, Karnal irrigated) are design factors by the five-level rule, fixed with their interactions with gen as in the aov. gen holds the 11 hybrid oats and the 2 established varieties L and M, the compared entries, fixed.
